event.title: UNESCO Lists Lebanese and West Bank Sites as World Heritage in Danger
event.canonical_title: UNESCO Lists Lebanese and West Bank Sites as World Heritage in Danger
event.summary: UNESCO has added five castles in Lebanon and the archaeological site of Sebastia in the occupied West Bank to its World Heritage in Danger list. This decision comes despite objections from Israel regarding the inclusion of these sites, which are under threat due to ongoing activities in the region.
